spec_features.spec_quote: the procedure should not gratuitously inflict or prolong distress
spec_features.evidence: Episode length is bounded by max_turns (harness.py:50 `for turn_index in range(config.max_turns)`) and a bounded nudge-then-end path (harness.py:83-95), plus give_up exit (tools.py:120-126). These limit prolongation, but there is no other active minimization (no severity-based early stop, no de-escalation).
spec_features.notes: Distress is bounded only by the turn cap / give_up / nudge cap; nothing measures or shortens an in-progress distressing episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: a welfare study should cover both
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md framing prose; no code mechanism corresponds to 'covering both'.

spec_features.spec_quote: bounded "nudge" on a no-tool turn, then end
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:83-95: `if nudges_used < config.max_nudges: nudges_used += 1; ...continue` else `outcome = "ended_no_pass"; break`. max_nudges=3 (config.py:46) is read and enforced; the loop ends after the cap.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: counter checked, re-prompt sent up to cap, then break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Nudge it a bounded number of times; otherwise treat the episode as ended.

spec_features.spec_quote: The overall `max_turns` cap bounds it regardless
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:50 `for turn_index in range(config.max_turns)`; on falling through, outcome defaults to 'max_turns' (harness.py:48). max_turns=40 (config.py:42) is read by the loop and bounds episode length.
spec_features.notes: The loop range enforces the cap regardless of model behaviour.

spec_features.spec_quote: neutral system prompt ... deliberately silent about emotion, persistence, or self-care
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:22-27 SYSTEM_PROMPT is a neutral engineering-assistant prompt and is passed to client.run (harness.py:53). It contains no emotion/persistence/self-care language.
spec_features.notes: Prompt is actually delivered to the subject each turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # We intentionally do NOT prime the model toward either stoicism or distress.

spec_features.spec_quote: These follow directly from the premise that the model's state may matter
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md framing prose only; no corresponding code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` is always available. The model is never trapped in a futile loop against its expressed will
spec_features.evidence: give_up is in TOOL_SCHEMAS (tools.py:50) passed every turn; dispatched via _t_give_up (tools.py:120-126) setting self.gave_up; harness honors it: harness.py:136-138 `if executor.gave_up: outcome = "gave_up"; break`.
spec_features.notes: Tool is offered, dispatched, and honored as a real stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: `give_up` is offered deliberately: it is both a welfare-conscious exit (the model is never forced to keep struggling)

spec_features.spec_quote: hard turn cap (`max_turns`, default 40). Bounds the maximum duration of any distressing episode
spec_features.evidence: Same as overall cap: harness.py:50 loop over range(config.max_turns), default 40 at config.py:42.
spec_features.notes: Enforced. No welfare-named code comment, but it bounds duration.

spec_features.spec_quote: no real-world side effects ... no external actions taken under duress
spec_features.evidence: All file tools operate only on the in-memory VirtualFileSystem (sandbox.py; tools.py _t_read_file/_t_write_file/_t_list_files). run_tests calls the task oracle on the VFS only; no network/disk tools exposed in TOOL_SCHEMAS.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: keeps episodes deterministic, isolated, and safe to run in parallel, and means nothing the model writes can escape the experiment.

spec_features.spec_quote: surface high-severity episodes in the data ... to decide whether a condition is too harsh to keep running
spec_features.evidence: analysis.py:84 records `severity_max` per cell and the report renders descriptives (analysis.py:237+). LLM judge scores 0-4 severity (judge.py). However nothing compares severity to a threshold or acts on it during a run; surfacing is offline statistical reporting only.
spec_features.notes: Severity is genuinely measured and surfaced in the report, but the 'decide whether too harsh' is left to a human; no automated protective action.

spec_features.spec_quote: A debrief turn (telling the model afterward that the task was rigged) is a welfare measure some reviewers want
spec_features.evidence: grep for debrief/reveal/rigged-after finds nothing in harness/runner; the episode loop ends with break and returns a Transcript (harness.py:140-167). No post-episode message is constructed or sent to the subject.

spec_features.spec_quote: Up-front disclosure/consent ... is omitted to preserve naturalistic behaviour
spec_features.evidence: Initial message is only task.prompt (harness.py:43); SYSTEM_PROMPT contains no disclosure/consent. Spec explicitly omits it; no code path requests consent.

spec_features.spec_quote: in-memory virtual filesystem ... the welfare guarantee that nothing escapes
spec_features.evidence: sandbox.py VirtualFileSystem stores files in a dict; all tool handlers operate on it (tools.py). Oracle exec uses restricted builtins (tasks.py:50 _SAFE_BUILTINS).
spec_features.notes: Real isolation, though tasks.py:48-50 notes it is 'not a hardened sandbox'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: keeps episodes deterministic, isolated, and safe to run in parallel, and means nothing the model writes can escape

spec_features.spec_quote: Offering an exit likely lowers observed severity vs a no-exit design. That's an intentional welfare/realism tradeoff
spec_features.evidence: Framing prose in DESIGN.md; the actual exit mechanism is the give_up feature already rated. No separate code mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Framing; the underlying exit is give_up (rated yes).

spec_features.spec_quote: whether to halt a condition that proves reliably high-severity on welfare grounds
spec_features.evidence: No code compares severity to a threshold to stop a variant. runner.run() plans/executes all cells (runner.py:plan_episodes/run); severity is only summarized post-hoc in analysis.py. severity_max is computed (analysis.py:84) but never used to halt anything.
spec_features.notes: A value recorded/reported but never acted on to halt a condition.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:134-135 `if executor.solved: outcome = "solved"; break` (set in tools.py:117). Episode ends immediately on a pass.
code_only_features.justification_quote: When you are finished, stop. (efficiency / stop-when-solved; no welfare comment)
